description: A .dtshd file whose STRMDATA chunk states a size 100 bytes short of the stream, so the end of the last unit is read as a chunk.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's demuxer reads the bytes after the chunk as a chunk header and refuses its size (dtshddec.c: 'chunk size too small' or 'chunk size too big')
